item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day is full of anchors, so use them. Meals tend to slip when the schedule gets busy, and a late dinner after a long afternoon usually means grazing or overdoing it. Decide now what you'll eat at midday and in the evening. Aim for protein and something green at both. Eat sitting down, without a screen. Your action: before noon, write down your dinner plan.
